scoring.team_score: sum(V) - USAGE_RATE*max(0, sum(usage)-USAGE_BUDGET) - SPACING_TAX*max(0, SPACERS_REQ-sum(sp)) + SPACING_BONUS*max(0, sum(sp)-SPACERS_REQ) - backcourt_def_tax(both guards bottom-25%/10% by dbpm: -2/-3) - wing_def_tax(both forwards bottom-25%/10% by dbpm: -2/-3)

meta.validation: Slim model (rim/playmaker/guard-height terms removed; usage + spacing + guard-defense kept), re-centered on 10 finishing-five lineup net ratings (real on-court Net Rtg, 1997-2024): BASELINE 3.73, NET_SD 12. Fit r 0.43, Spearman 0.24, MAE 3.1 net pts. Anchors are all elite (+14.6 to +23.9), a narrow band that caps achievable correlation; spacing is retained as a deliberate modern-game design choice.
meta.box_stats: rpg/apg/spg/bpg joined 2026-06-12 from Player Per Game.csv (same compilation), keyed on (player, season, team); 100% match, pts cross-validated vs ppg (max skew 0.1 on in-progress 2026 rows)
meta.positions: G/F/C buckets (G = PG+SG minutes, F = SF+PF, C = C); a player is eligible for a bucket at >=20% of his minutes there, from Player Play By Play.csv (1997+). Pre-1997 rows use the listed primary position as a single bucket. Lineup: 2 G, 2 F, 1 C.
meta.spacing: 3pt-shooter flag, sp=1, must match Jokic's 2023-24 season percentile-wise within the player's own season/league (NBA/ABA separate, >=100 total minutes): 3-pointers-made-per-game percentile >= Jokic's 2024 makes-percentile (~59th, ranked vs all qualified) AND 3P% percentile >= Jokic's 2024 3P%-percentile (~54th, ranked among SHOOTERS ONLY, i.e. players with 3PA>0). Bars fixed to Jokic 2024, applied per season. Pre-1979-80 NBA had no 3pt line, so those players are never spacers. A manual override (meta.sp_override) forces sp=1 in all seasons for named early-era shooters whose 3PT volume predates reliable per-game tracking. A categorical non-shooter list (meta.sp_never) forces sp=0 in all seasons for named players (applied after sp_override).
meta.awards: Defensive bonus added to bpm_star with one-year carry-over (made the team that season or +/-1 year, taken once as the max in the window): All-Defensive 1st +0.75, All-Defensive 2nd +0.5. No DPOY bonus -- DPOY voting is too noisy a signal of defensive value (it routinely skips great defenders), so the broader All-Defense selections carry the bonus instead. All-Defense from End of Season Teams.csv; NBA only.
meta.backcourt: Backcourt DEFENSE penalty on the two G-slot players. Guard-defense tiers use dbpm percentiles among guard-eligible seasons (g_pct>=20, all-time): bottom-25% = dbpm<=GD_BOTTOM25 (-1.0), bottom-10% = dbpm<=GD_BOTTOM10 (-1.7). If BOTH guards are bottom-25%: -2.0; if BOTH are bottom-10%: -3.0 (worse tier replaces, not additive). dbpm from Advanced.csv, joined on (player,season,team), 100% match.
meta.wing: Wing DEFENSE penalty on the two F-slot players, mirroring the backcourt rule. Forward-defender dbpm percentiles are taken across all forward-eligible seasons (f_pct>=20, all-time): bottom-25% = dbpm<=FD_BOTTOM25 (-0.9), bottom-10% = dbpm<=FD_BOTTOM10 (-1.5). If BOTH forwards are bottom-25%: -2.0; if BOTH are bottom-10%: -3.0 (worse tier replaces, not additive). dbpm from Advanced.csv, joined 100%.
